notes: A new starter cast. Chef Rosa stays; the writing partner, dungeon master, coach, professor and listener are retired and replaced by a household — Amy, Lilly, Erin, Harper and Jess, each with their own temperament, way of speaking, history and written appearance rather than a one-line label. The Family group chat replaces the old writing team. Upgrading is careful about it: a retired character you actually held a conversation with is kept, along with everything they remember, and only the ones you never opened are cleared away. Two long-standing crashes are fixed along the way — group chats and the no-API-key fallback both assumed every character carried scripted replies, which no character you made yourself ever has.
